journeys.name: Find dictionary entries with Japanese or English text
journeys.goal: Enter a query and inspect ranked dictionary matches.
journeys.fixture: Synthetic public Japanese or English query
journeys.visible_result: Best Matches and, when applicable, Additional Matches and an example-sentence count action.
journeys.durable_output: The query becomes a recent-search entry; no Saved Language Item is implied.
failure_and_recovery: No-match is a blank content state with no explicit copy or retry control
Offline, injected failure, loading, and retry behavior remain uncaptured
Cancel dismisses focus while the last populated result set can remain visible

journeys.name: Resolve an ambiguous romaji query to Japanese
journeys.goal: Use the offered Japanese reading when literal Latin-script matching is ambiguous.
actions: Observe literal ranking and Search for Japanese reading action
journeys.visible_result: The query is normalized to Japanese and results are reranked for that reading.
journeys.durable_output: The submitted forms can become recent-search entries.
failure_and_recovery: nihon and mondai offered Japanese-reading refinement
taberu and tabeta resolved directly without a refinement row
The complete transliteration decision boundary remains owned by the language-behavior capture ticket

journeys.name: Rerun a recent Search query
journeys.goal: Return to an earlier lookup from Search history.
journeys.visible_result: The selected query's result set is shown.
journeys.durable_output: A session-created query appeared as the top recent-search row and selecting it restored the result set; storage location and cold-relaunch persistence remain uncaptured.
failure_and_recovery: Clear All is destructive and was not exercised
Pre-existing personal entries were neither recorded nor used
Individual disposable-row removal awaits action-time confirmation

journeys.name: Compose a Search query by handwriting
journeys.goal: Draw Japanese characters and submit them as a Search query.
journeys.visible_result: A handwriting panel exposes a drawing grid, erase control, and Search action.
journeys.durable_output: A submitted recognized query can enter Search history.
failure_and_recovery: Candidate generation, candidate selection, multi-character composition, single-kanji and common-kanji result submission were captured
A pending recognized stroke is included on Search without selecting its candidate
Exact single-stroke erase semantics and low-confidence/no-candidate behavior remain uncaptured

journeys.name: Compose a Search query from radicals
journeys.goal: Select radicals grouped by stroke count and search for matching kanji.
journeys.visible_result: A radical grid grouped by stroke count exposes remove and Search actions.
journeys.durable_output: A submitted query can enter Search history.
failure_and_recovery: Selection, deselection, filtering, multi-radical narrowing, candidate selection, and submission results were captured
Search remains disabled before a candidate kanji is chosen
Zero-candidate and very-large candidate-set behavior remain uncaptured

journeys.name: Inspect a dictionary word entry
journeys.goal: Read pronunciation, senses, alternatives, kanji relationships, notes, and examples for a result.
journeys.fixture: Synthetic public query with common and rare matches
actions: Follow an in-scope related word when needed
journeys.visible_result: A structured word entry with reading, frequency badge, pitch display, audio, parts of speech, meanings, alternatives, relationships, notes, and examples.
journeys.durable_output: None unless the learner edits a note or crosses the excluded Flashcard boundary.
failure_and_recovery: Missing field combinations and loading or offline behavior remain uncaptured

journeys.name: Read and traverse example sentences
journeys.goal: Read example sentences for a query and inspect an underlined language item.
journeys.visible_result: Furigana-bearing Japanese, English translation, audio per example, and linked word tokens.
failure_and_recovery: No-example, pagination, and audio failure behavior remain uncaptured

journeys.name: Hear a word or example pronounced
journeys.goal: Play pronunciation audio from a word entry or example.
journeys.fixture: Public entry with an enabled speaker control
journeys.visible_result: Speaker controls are available at word and example levels.
failure_and_recovery: Playback source, progress, interruption, silent mode, route, network, and failure states remain uncaptured

journeys.name: Inspect plain and polite conjugations
journeys.goal: Compare conjugated forms for a conjugating entry.
journeys.visible_result: Verb-class title and a mode-specific list of tense, polarity, te-form, potential, passive, causative, conditional, volitional, and imperative forms.
failure_and_recovery: Other conjugating classes, irregular forms, missing forms, and selection persistence remain uncaptured

journeys.name: Add or edit a note on a word entry
journeys.goal: Attach learner-authored text to the current entry.
journeys.fixture: Rare public entry without an existing note
journeys.visible_result: The note area becomes editable and the navigation bar exposes Done.
journeys.durable_output: Expected entry note; persistence was intentionally not created during reconnaissance.
failure_and_recovery: Empty note exits without an observed change
Persistence, deletion, validation, and relaunch behavior remain uncaptured

journeys.name: Inspect a kanji entry and linked words
journeys.goal: Understand a kanji's classification, meanings, readings, elements, origin, and related words.
journeys.fixture: Public kanji reached from a synthetic word query
actions: Select a reading-linked or related word
journeys.visible_result: Glyph, strokes, grade, JLPT, meanings, readings, elements, origin/history, and related-word rows.
failure_and_recovery: Missing metadata variants and link cycles remain uncaptured

journeys.name: Step through kanji stroke order
journeys.goal: See a kanji drawn one stroke at a time.
journeys.visible_result: A modal drawing grid with stroke index and playback controls.
failure_and_recovery: Autoplay timing, terminal state, rapid input, and background interruption remain uncaptured

journeys.name: Inspect a kanji element and its roles
journeys.goal: Understand how an element contributes meaning, category, or sound across kanji.
journeys.fixture: Public kanji entry containing linked elements
journeys.visible_result: Element glyph, explanation, role sections, standalone-kanji row, and linked kanji lists.
failure_and_recovery: Element-role variants and absent sections remain uncaptured
